scripts.rebuild: npm run clean && npm run compile

hornet-cpp.mode.description: Parsing mode. Compiler and Hybrid are available; saved unavailable modes use Compiler for the current session.

hornet-cpp.clangd.path.description: Absolute path or PATH name of clangd on the workspace host. The default searches PATH, LLVM and editor-managed installations, then downloads an official clangd release if missing. Manual selection is optional.

hornet-cpp.clangd.arguments.description: Additional clangd arguments. Hornet manages compile database, config execution, threads and query-driver.

hornet-cpp.clangd.queryDriver.description: Explicit allowlist of compiler paths clangd may execute. Empty disables driver probing.

hornet-cpp.clangd.ignoreDiagnostics.description: Diagnostic filtering. not_indexed requires an explicit compile command; Hybrid always filters uncovered files.

hornet-cpp.cpuUsage.description: clangd worker thread budget: 100%, 75%, 50%, or 25% of host logical CPUs (at least one).

hornet-cpp.excludePaths.description: Exclude patterns for manual folder synchronization. clangd controls its own background index.

languageModelTools.name: cpptools-lmtool-configuration
languageModelTools.modelDescription: For the active C or C++ file, this tool provides: the language (C, C++, or CUDA), the language standard version (such as C++11, C++14, C++17, or C++20), the compiler (such as GCC, Clang, or MSVC), the target platform (such as x86, x64, or ARM), and the target architecture (such as 32-bit or 64-bit).

scripts.test: yarn install && (yarn verify prep --quiet || yarn prep) && (yarn verify compiled --quiet || yarn build) && ts-node -T .scripts/test.ts
scripts.code: yarn install && (yarn verify compiled --quiet || yarn build) && yarn verify binaries && ts-node -T .scripts/code.ts
scripts.prep: yarn prep:dts && yarn copy-walkthrough-media && yarn generate-native-strings && yarn translations-generate
scripts.lint: yarn install && eslint --report-unused-disable-directives src test ui .scripts
scripts.compile: yarn install && (yarn verify prep --quiet || yarn prep) && yarn build
scripts.watch: yarn install && (yarn verify prep --quiet || yarn prep) && tsc --build tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.rebuild: yarn install && yarn clean && yarn prep && yarn build
scripts.vsix-prepublish: npm run bootstrap && yarn clean && yarn webpack
scripts.webpack: yarn install --frozen-lockfile && (yarn verify prep --quiet || yarn prep) && tsc --build ui.tsconfig.json && webpack --mode production --env vscode_nls
scripts.translations-export: yarn install && yarn prep && yarn generate-native-strings && gulp translations-export
scripts.prep:dts: yarn verify dts --quiet || (npx @vscode/dts main && npx @vscode/dts dev && yarn verify proposals)
scripts.build: yarn prep:dts && echo [Building TypeScript code] && tsc --build tsconfig.json
